subject: LumenHealth — additional teams & credentialing plan
messages:
From: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@lumenhealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LumenHealth — additional teams & credentialing plan

Hi Priya / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We had a follow-up with the product leads this morning and they're asking how we should handle expansion across three additional teams (Search, Diagnostics, and Patient Intake). High-level asks:

- How are API keys typically provisioned per project/team? We want key-level isolation and per-team quotas.
- Do we need a contract amendment to add projects and raise committed capacity, or can this be handled administratively?
- Rough timeline and what you need from our side (PO, SOW, onboarding info).

I've attached a short roster with the teams and lead contacts to help scope expected usage (LH_project_roster.xlsx).

Targets (ballpark): Search ~ 6M tokens/month, Diagnostics ~ 2.5M tokens/month, Patient Intake ~ 1.2M tokens/month. These are estimates — we can firm them up if you need per-endpoint breakdowns.

Can we aim to kick off provisioning in mid-August? Prefer a quick sync to align next steps. Looping in Ben for pricing and Monica for onboarding.

Thanks,
Alex
Product Ops — LumenHealth
alex.thompson@lumenhealth.com
Attachment: LH_project_roster.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenHealth — additional teams & credentialing plan

Hi Alex — great to see the roster, thanks.

Short answers up front: we can provision per-team API keys with isolated quotas and separate telemetry. For committed-capacity / pricing: if you want predictable unit economics and a discount for the additional steady usage, we typically handle that via a small amendment during renewal (or a mid-term amendment if you prefer).

Suggested next steps:
- You: confirm estimated monthly token ranges for each team (the numbers you included are perfect as a starting point).
- Redwood: we'll draft a one-page amendment that adds the three projects, maps them to key namespaces, and proposes an incremental committed capacity + discount.
- Ops: Monica will prepare the onboarding checklist and a key-provisioning template so your engineers can stand up keys without manual steps.

Proposed timing:
- Draft amendment and provisioning plan: Aug 6
- Review call (30m): Aug 9–10 (your availability?)
- Kickoff for provisioning & sandbox keys: week of Aug 16

Ben — can you put together a preliminary price band for the incremental committed tokens and one-off onboarding credit?

Monica — I'll need the standard onboarding checklist and a brief runbook for key rotation to include in the PO.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
--
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference platform

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Aug 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenHealth — additional teams & credentialing plan

Alex / Priya / Monica — quick note on pricing and commercial path.

Summary proposal (preliminary):
- Incremental committed capacity: +10M tokens/month (covers the three teams with headroom).
- Suggested committed term: 12 months (aligns with your renewal cadence).
- Discount: 12% off hosted API list rates on the incremental committed volume.
- Onboarding credit: one-time $5,000 credit applied after keys are live and first month usage reported.

If that looks reasonable, I'll generate a short amendment (1–2 pages) that lists the new project names, maps them to key namespaces, and includes the deal id DEAL-2027-0543. We'll add a simple acceptance clause: keys provisioned -> onboarding credit applied after 30 days.

Attachments: Lumen_Amendment_Draft_v1.pdf (draft amendment, redline-ready).

Next operational asks for LumenHealth:
- PO or commercial authorization (for finance) referencing DEAL-2027-0543
- Primary technical contact for each team for key provisioning and roles/ RBAC
- Any special compliance requirements (e.g., data residency or SOC2 evidence requests) — call those out now so Monica can coordinate with our security team.

I can be on the Aug 9–10 review call.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachment: Lumen_Amendment_Draft_v1.pdf

From: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@lumenhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rachel Lee <rachel.lee@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Aug 2027 15:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenHealth — additional teams & credentialing plan

Thanks everyone — this looks good. A few quick responses inline and next actions.

> Suggested timing:
> - Draft amendment and provisioning plan: Aug 6
> - Review call (30m): Aug 9–10
> - Kickoff for provisioning & sandbox keys: week of Aug 16

Aug 6 for the draft works. We can do Aug 10 at 10:00am PT for the review call. Kickoff week of Aug 16 also works.

Usage estimates (refined):
- Search: 6.5M tokens/month
- Diagnostics: 3.0M tokens/month
- Patient Intake: 1.1M tokens/month

We'll raise a PO referencing DEAL-2027-0543 once we have the amendment.

Legal note: attaching signed mutual NDA and looping in our counsel Rachel Lee for any contract redlines.

Rachel Lee (legal) — if you could skim the amendment draft and flag anything material, that would be great.

Action items agreed:
- Ben: finalize amendment with the 12% discount and onboarding credit, send redlineable PDF by Aug 6.
- Priya / Monica: prepare provisioning runbook and key namespace mapping.
- Lumen: internal PO to follow after amendment review.

Thanks — Alex
